text:
maya: saw a spike — ~3k reqs with keys missing project claim. routed to org-default and blew past project quotas :grimacing:
kevin: ugh. which path? proxy or gateway?
sanjay: gateway. logs show JWTs with service_id but no project_id claim. likely token minted before new claim check landed.
olivia: is that the fallthrough behavior we intentionally added? default->org->billing-project? I thought we blocked route if project absent.
maya: fallback pipeline currently: if project claim missing, use key->org->first-project mapping. that's the legacy behavior.
kevin: that's the one causing surprise. product expects explicit project to be required for quota attribution.
julie: tagging for console UX — customers see token usage assigned to project X unexpectedly. ops gets alerts. we need clearer visibility + opt-out.
aaron: quick question — do we have telemetry to surface how often fallthrough happened and how many tokens were retro-attributed?
infra-bot: query-run-complete: "SELECT count(*) FROM auth_events WHERE project_id IS NULL AND downstream_project IS NOT NULL AND ts >= '2026-03-01'" -> 3124 rows.
sanjay: ok ~3.1k matches maya's number. half from a single org.
kevin: proposal: change default behavior on next canary to reject requests lacking project claim unless org has explicit project-mapping flag enabled. keep legacy mapping behind a gate.
maya: sounds safe. need migration plan: backfill attribution for historical logs and ensure dashboard doesn't lose continuity.
julie: for dashboard — show a new line item "fallthrough-attributed" with link to list of keys. customers can opt into preserving old mapping for 30 days.
olivia: telemetry: add tag auth.fallthrough=true and origin=legacy-mapping so we can filter. sample 100% for first 24 hours, then 1%.
aaron: also emit metric auth.fallthrough.rate and auth.fallthrough.per-org.<org_id> so SRE can set alerts.
kevin: rollout plan: 1) add telemetry + gate, 2) ship canary rejecting-missing-project to 5% orgs with opt-in flag, 3) 24h monitoring, 4) widen to 50% with email notifications, 5) flip default after 2 weeks.
sanjay: code snippet for gate check I hacked:
```
// pseudo
if (!claims.project_id) {
  if (org.flags.allow_legacy_mapping) {
    project = org.mapping.first_project
    emit_metric("auth.fallthrough", 1, {org:org.id})
  } else {
    return 403, "missing project claim"
  }
}
```
kevin: ensure we log key fingerprint and token-issuer to aid debugging. don't log raw token.
julie: UX note: Console should show a banner for affected orgs with link "Resolve tokens missing project claim" and a one-click migration to create project mappings.
maya: legal/regulatory check — are we changing billing attribution retroactively? finance ok with short backfill but want audit log.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist: telemetry flagged, gate config added, console-banner draft (PR #4123), canary-run plan drafted.
aaron: I'll add dashboards: time-series for fallthrough.count and per-key heatmap. will include an alert for >100 events in 1h for any org.
kevin: ok let's aim to ship telemetry + gate by EOD. canary next Tues. pinging @olivia for console copy.
olivia: got it. will draft banner copy now.
maya: thanks all — followups: julie own console banner, sanjay own gateway gate config, aaron dashboards, kevin run canary. will update thread with PRs and timestamps. :thumbsup:
